plugin.note: Phase 1 ground form best meleed. Keris partisan of breaching is the standout kalphite weapon on crush. Slayer helm (i) on task is the biggest single DPS gain.

requirements: Use Slayer helmet or Slayer helmet (i) when killing her on a Kalphite task.
Bring phase-two gear as a switch or use the combined Kalphite Queen strategy for full-trip planning.
mechanics: The crawling first form uses protection prayers against Magic and Ranged as defence indicators rather than full immunity.
The crawling form is weakest to crush and is best handled with melee.
Keris partisan of breaching and Keris partisan benefit from the Kalphite attribute.
Defence reduction on the first form carries over to the airborne form.

methods.label: Phase 1 melee
methods.summary: Melee the crawling form with Keris partisan of breaching, Keris partisan, or another strong crush weapon.
requiredOrKeyItems: Dragon claws for special attack if used
steps: Use Slayer helmet or Slayer helmet (i) when on task.
Attack the crawling form with Keris partisan of breaching or Keris partisan on crush.
Use other strong melee crush weapons if Keris partisan options are unavailable.
Prepare to switch styles after the 12-second transition to the airborne form.
notes: This JSON migrates the previous Kalphite Queen crawling-form Markdown strategy.

methods.label: Phase 1 defence reduction
methods.summary: Use Dragon warhammer or Elder maul special attacks to lower Defence before meleeing the crawling form.
steps: Start the kill with Protect from Magic and Piety active where supplies allow.
Use Elder maul or Dragon warhammer special attacks to reduce the Queen's Defence.
Switch to Keris partisan of breaching, Keris partisan, Scythe of vitur on crush, Soulreaper axe on crush, or another crush weapon.
Use crush style for Keris and most melee options.
Be ready to change to phase-two ranged or magic gear after the transformation.
risks: The Queen's melee, ranged, and magic pressure can force eating during missed defence specs.
Kalphite Workers can spawn from cocoons while the Queen is being hit.
notes: Dragon claws are another special-attack option when using a melee setup.
Slayer helmet bonuses are a major damage increase on task.

styleOptions.label: Melee crush
styleOptions.summary: Phase-one melee setup using Keris or crush weapons.

body:
# Kalphite Queen (crawling form)

Phase 1 ground form best meleed. Keris partisan of breaching is the standout kalphite weapon on crush. Slayer helm (i) on task is the biggest single DPS gain.
